display_name: Provision lifecycle IAM roles for a birther
description: Create or update the <birther>-midwife and <birther>-undertaker IAM roles for a birther solet. Each role gets its scoped inline policy + trust policy. Idempotent under re-runs: existing roles whose trust policy hash + inline policy hash + tag set already match the expected shape for the supplied policy_template_version are no-op-skipped; drift triggers UpdateAssumeRolePolicy + PutRolePolicy + TagRole. Same call IS the rotation path per design §6.2 (idempotency-as-rotation insight closed under D30'). Plugin is herky-jerky-loaded — verb present in registry only during operator-initiated apply_manifest cycles that ADD the bound plugin. dry_run=true returns the planned step list without any state-changing IAM calls. role_names_required is a subset of ["midwife", "undertaker"]; the <solet>-self-deployment role is midwife scope (created per-solet at birth time), and the <birther>-admin role itself is operator-manual (chicken-and-egg).
embedding_description: Provision IAM lifecycle roles for a birther capability. Creates the quartet's create-able roles (midwife + undertaker) with scoped inline policies and tag-based idempotency. Same verb handles rotation when policy_template_version bumps. Admin role is operator-manual; self-deployment role is midwife scope. Herky-jerky-loaded; verb only present during transient admin cycles.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: AdminResult envelope per ananta.interfaces.lifecycle_result_types.AdminResult: status (success / partial / failed / rejected / dry_run), birther_name (echo), idempotency_key (16-hex sha256), dry_run (echo), verb='provision_lifecycle_roles', steps (per-role audit; each entry has role / status / role_arn / detail), roles_provisioned (tuple of ARNs created or updated this attempt; empty when no state changed), policy_template_version (echo), message (human-readable).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with status. When status='success' or 'dry_run', surface the per-role step statuses (created / updated_to_current / skipped_already_current / dry_run_planned) so operator sees the diff at a glance. When status='partial' or 'failed', surface the failing per-role steps verbatim with their AWS error codes. When status='rejected', surface the message (no_roles_specified / policy_template_version_unsupported / etc.) — the verb did NOT call AWS. The idempotency_key is the tag operators can use to find this attempt's prior work via iam:ListRoleTags.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Provision <birther>-midwife and <birther>-undertaker IAM roles via the assumed <birther>-admin role.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: AssumeRoleFailure: the address-book entry 'aws_admin_role' resolved a role the plugin's base identity cannot assume; the role MUST exist AND its trust policy MUST permit the solet's task role (or local operator credentials). policy_template_version_unsupported: the supplied version is not in the plugin's blessed list; update the plugin before claiming a new version. no_roles_specified: role_names_required was empty. provision_already_in_flight_for_birther: another call for the same birther_name is in-flight on this plugin instance; retry after it completes. EntityAlreadyExists from a parallel admin instance: rare; second call sees the role and idempotency check folds it into a no-op.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: AssumeRoleFailure: fix the address-book entry or the role's trust policy (operator-side AWS console work). policy_template_version_unsupported: pin a supported version OR update the plugin and re-issue. no_roles_specified: pass at least one of ["midwife", "undertaker"]. Mid-flight: wait, the resume-via-tag-introspection contract on the next attempt picks up partial work cleanly.
